hook: KBR parking tower only *50%* full amid flyover works
hook_b: KBR parking tower only *50%* full amid flyover works
tldr: Steel flyover works and a one-way loop around KBR Park are keeping motorists away from Hyderabad's first automated multi-level car park at Entry-1.

beats.what: Barricades and machinery for the steel flyover from Jubilee Hills Check Post to NFCL Junction have narrowed roads, with peak-hour diversions in force.
beats.why: Construction and one-way traffic have complicated entry and exit to the parking bay, a senior GHMC official said.
beats.care: Users want access to the tower built into the construction traffic plan and no-parking rules enforced on roadsides.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The RFID-enabled tower has EV charging points and 24/7 CCTV.
